items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: And neither would they book what's-his-name? Richard Pryor? Him, neither.

ctx.x: Same as Noble Sissle, I figured he could make more money with his band than he could with his partner, but he didn't. In my estimation he didn't. He went to the dogs it seemed to me after that, but God rest his soul, he was all right.

But that's the way life goes. Who's going to know how to do life -- nobody. So you see, George, when you talk about show business I'm thinking -- see, what hurts me more or less about this business is I was in it so long and made it clean for the negro with entertainment that the negro was received. People like Redd Foxx wouldn't have been received in the theaters in those days because he has a dirty act. They wouldn't book him. And neither would they book what's-his-name? Richard Pryor? Him, neither. And most of…
